sloka: तस्य विश्रममाणस्य शुनःशेपो महायशाः ।पुष्करम् ज्येष्ठम् आगम्य विश्वामित्रम् ददर्श ह ॥१-६२-२॥
transliteration: tasya viśramamāṇasya śunaḥśepo mahāyaśāḥ ।puṣkaram jyeṣṭham āgamya viśvāmitram dadarśa ha ॥1-62-2॥

translations.english: While the king was resting at Pushkara, the famous Sunassepha, very much distressed, happened to see his maternal uncle Viswamitra in the company of other sages performing austerities.
translations.hindi: हो अत्याख्यातो हि दुबुंद्धे गुरुणा सत्यवादिना । ते कथं समतिक्रम्य शाखान्तरमुपेयिवान्‌
